title: Show Difficulty Graph
description: Display instantaneous difficulty strain timeline graph below the level badge

title: Show Song Title
description: Display beatmap title and difficulty name

title: Show Decimal Precision
description: Show decimal level precision (e.g. Lv. 94.2 instead of Lv. 94)

title: Show Timeline & Peak Timestamps
description: Display current playback time, peak spike timestamp, and total song duration

title: Hide Overlay for Non-7K
description: Hide the entire overlay when playing non-7K maps

title: Graph Height (px)
description: Height of the difficulty strain timeline graph in pixels (40 to 140)

title: Overlay Scale
description: Scale factor for the overlay widget (0.5 to 2.0)

title: Card Background Opacity
description: Opacity factor for the background card (0.1 to 1.0)

title: Accent Color
description: Accent color for level number, rate badge, and strain curve
